input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/check_1.py
+import csv
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+PARQUET = "data/crashes.parquet"
+START_YEAR = 2013
+END_YEAR = 2025
+
+db = duckdb.connect()
+facts = []
+year_records = []
+
+for year in range(START_YEAR, END_YEAR + 1):
+    start = f"{year}-01-01"
+    end = f"{year + 1}-01-01"
+    row_count, first_date, last_date, missing_dates, missing_pedestrian_death_counts = db.execute(
+        """
+        SELECT count(*), min(crash_date), max(crash_date),
+               count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL),
+               count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL)
+        FROM read_parquet(?)
+        WHERE crash_date >= ?::DATE AND crash_date < ?::DATE
+        """,
+        [PARQUET, start, end],
+    ).fetchone()
+    year_records.append((year, row_count))
+    facts.extend(
+        [
+            (f"population_rows_year_{year}", row_count),
+            (f"crash_date_missing_rows_year_{year}", missing_dates),
+            (
+                f"number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_year_{year}",
+                missing_pedestrian_death_counts,
+            ),
+            (
+                f"observed_crash_date_span_year_{year}",
+                f"{first_date} to {last_date}" if row_count else "no rows",
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+
+total = sum(count for _, count in year_records)
+facts.insert(0, ("population_rows_2013_2025", total))
+
+with open("out/check_1.csv", "w", newline="") as output:
+    writer = csv.writer(output)
+    writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+    writer.writerows(facts)
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/analyze_1.py
+import csv
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+PARQUET = "data/crashes.parquet"
+START_YEAR = 2013
+END_YEAR = 2025
+
+db = duckdb.connect()
+rows = db.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [PARQUET],
+).fetchall()
+
+with open("out/values_1.csv", "w", newline="") as output:
+    writer = csv.writer(output)
+    writer.writerow(["year", "pedestrian_deaths"])
+    writer.writerows(rows)
+
+years = [row[0] for row in rows]
+deaths = [row[1] for row in rows]
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+bars = ax.bar(years, deaths, color="#286090", width=0.72)
+ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=8)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrian deaths recorded in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes\n"
+    "Annual count, grouped by crash year (2013–2025)",
+    loc="left",
+    fontsize=13,
+    pad=14,
+)
+ax.text(
+    0,
+    1.01,
+    "Limitation: police-reported crashes only; observed dates span each full calendar year.",
+    transform=ax.transAxes,
+    fontsize=9,
+    color="#555555",
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year of crash")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrian deaths (sum of recorded deaths)")
+ax.set_xticks(range(START_YEAR, END_YEAR + 1))
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.7)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
*** End Patch
